d:
A dominant start to the title defence!
Kishore Mahato's brilliant 4-wicket haul, supported by Sher Malla's 3 wickets, helped Lumbini Lions bundle out Sudurpaschim Royals for just 87 runs.
In reply, D'Arcy Short's explosive 40 off 18 balls, alongside Aasif Sheikh's 32, powered Lumbini Lions to a commanding 7-wicket victory with more than 10 overs to spare!
